summary: [Escalation] Workaround request: official guidance for occasional SSE stream stalls on OpenAI-compatible API
description:
Customer asked if Redwood has recommended client-side retry/backoff guidance for streaming, specifically for cases where the stream stalls and they do not receive a [DONE] event.

Support guidance provided:
- Set an application-level watchdog timeout for no-bytes-received (e.g., 15s) and reconnect + replay request idempotently.
- Ensure proxies/LBs have high idle timeouts for SSE.
- Prefer HTTP/1.1 for some environments if HTTP/2 intermediaries are problematic.

Outcome:
- Customer implemented watchdog + increased idle timeouts; marked resolved.
comments: grace_oconnor (Support): Logging as escalation question. Customer seeing rare stalls; wants official best practice to avoid hanging UI.
soojin_lee (DevEx): Sent recommended SSE client guidance + link to streaming contract page.
grace_oconnor (Support): Customer confirmed guidance works. Closing.
